hero_desc: In the heart of the charming village of Bollezeele in inland Flanders.
car_desc: Quick access via the A25 (Exit 15 Wormhout / Herzeele or Exit 14). 20 minutes from Dunkirk and 45 minutes from Lille. Private, secure on-site parking.
shuttle_desc: Just 35 minutes from the Eurotunnel terminal at Calais and the ferries via the A26/A25. An ideal stopover for our visitors from the United Kingdom.
train_desc: Nearest TGV / TER stations: Hazebrouck (20 min) and Dunkirk (25 min).
surroundings_title: Things to Do in the Area
surroundings_desc: Between the Monts de Flandre, fortified towns and wild coastline, explore the cultural and natural riches surrounding Bollezeele.

news.title: Terroir & Seasonal Tasting Menu
news.desc: The chef of the PAUZE restaurant honours Flemish producers with an exceptional, short-lived menu.

news.title: Flanders Escape Weekend
news.desc: Enjoy one night with an artisan breakfast buffet and unlimited access to our relaxation areas.

contact_desc: Our team is at your complete disposal to answer all your questions and prepare your visit to Bollezeele.
